This confirms the finding — no Redis anywhere in the repo, and the user cache TTL is 10 minutes via the default config.

r01.

**Premise correction:** There is no Redis in this codebase — I found zero references to Redis (client libraries, connection strings, env vars, or config) anywhere in the repo. Memos (this project) does not use an external cache store at all.

**Actual mechanism:** Caching is done via a custom thread-safe in-memory cache (`sync.Map`-backed) implemented at `store/cache/cache.go:69-90`. The `Store` struct instantiates three separate in-process caches — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, and `userSettingCache` — in `store/store.go:38-60`. All three, including `userCache`, are constructed with the same `cacheConfig`:

```go
cacheConfig := cache.Config{
    DefaultTTL:      10 * time.Minute,
    CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute,
    MaxItems:        1000,
    OnEviction:      nil,
}
```
(`store/store.go:40-45`)

So user entries cached via `s.userCache.Set(...)` (e.g. `store/user.go:98,122,132,143,167`) use the default TTL of **10 minutes**, with a background cleanup sweep every 5 minutes (`store/cache/cache.go:59-66`, `cleanupLoop`/`cleanup` at lines 218-253) and an eviction ceiling of 1000 items per cache (`cleanupOldest`, lines 256-306).
